messages:
hana-partnerops: Partner 'EchoGrid' pinged — they see double-counting in marketplace usage after integrating our SDK + local gateway. They claim one side of their stack emits 'session' records and another emits 'token' deltas for the same user interaction.
kevin-revops: looked at the ledger: same event_id appears twice with different metering_type fields. Our pipeline currently treats metering_type as independent dimensions so both rows counted.
omar-plateng: can you paste sanitized examples?
hana-partnerops: sample payloads (redacted):
```
{customer_id: 'echo-42', event_ts: '2026-03-22T16:05:00Z', event_id: 'evt-9001', sku: 'eg-gen', metering_type: 'session', units: 1}
{customer_id: 'echo-42', event_ts: '2026-03-22T16:05:01Z', event_id: 'evt-9001', sku: 'eg-gen', metering_type: 'tokens', units: 134}
```
rachel-sales: partner says their commercial contract bills only by session for this product, tokens are an internal telemetry artifact from the gateway. They want tokens excluded from billing.
kevin-revops: contractual truth wins, but we need defensible ingest rules. Two approaches: 1) partner-provided metering_contract field that declares which metering_type is billable per sku 2) heuristic: if two events share event_id and same sku within 10s, prefer the metering_type with higher priority (configurable per partner) and mark the other as exploratory.
siva-ml: we can auto-detect duplicates by event_id fingerprint and compute a scoring function: S(metering_type) = contract_priority + normalized_units_weight. We can surface the score and auto-classify with a confidence label.
omar-plateng: implementation detail: ledger-bridge should compute canonical_metering = coalesce(partner_config.billable_metering[sku], resolver(event_id_group)). If canonical_metering != incoming.metering_type then mark event as held_for_recon=true and store original_metering in metadata. Aggregator will count only canonical_metering types for billing snapshots.
hana-partnerops: timeline & partner comms? partner wants immediate relief; they stopped heavy traffic for now.
rachel-sales: offer a temporary whitelist so EchoGrid gets tokens excluded while we implement policy. Also request signed metering_contract CSV with columns: sku, billable_metering_type, effective_from.
kevin-revops: agree. Short-term: add partner-level override flag in partner profile to ignore metering_type X for billing. Medium-term: implement canonicalization logic + scoring and reconciliation UI.
siva-ml: I'll provide a rulepack that flags event_id collisions and computes confidence. Start with deterministic rules: same event_id & same sku & units>0 within 10s => conflict.
partnerbot: webhook: /marketplace/webhook delivery 200 OK for echogrid; signature valid.
omar-plateng: owners: omar -> partner-level override + ingest flag by EOD; kevin -> ledger-bridge canonical_metering logic + hold flag by Thu; siva -> classifier rules + export confidence by Thu; hana -> partner advisory + whitelist + request signed CSV by tomorrow.
kevin-revops: metrics: number of event_id collisions, percent of collisions auto-resolved, partner-claimed adjustments, time-to-clear holds. Add alert if collisions >0.5% of partner volume.
rachel-sales: we'll offer EchoGrid one invoice credit for the month if they accept the preview corrections. Keeps churn risk low.
hana-partnerops: thanks. i'll schedule a 30-min sync with EchoGrid tomorrow 09:00 PT to confirm whitelist and review preview S3 link. :thumbsup:
thread_text_snippet: EchoGrid double-counts because gateway emits both 'session' and 'tokens' for same event_id; plan: partner whitelist + canonical_metering rules, hold conflicting rows, classifier and partner CSV contract
